meaning:
Kirjath-sepher or Kirjath-sannah = "city of the book"
a town in the mountains of Judah to the west of Hebron
Another name of de.vir (דְּבִיר "Debir" H1688A)

elsewhere.note: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.
From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)
